digest.component_or_area: terraform-drift gate and Gerrit CI integration
propositions: Terraform drift check does not run for Gerrit changes, only for pull_request, push to main, and scheduled triggers, so un-applied infrastructure can be submitted without detection.

A change touching infra/terraform/** can receive Verified +1 and merge to main with unapplied resources, because the drift gate only executes post-merge and fails after the change is already committed.

The terraform-drift workflow uses terraform plan with -detailed-exitcode to detect drift, but this check does not distinguish between a change's own not-yet-applied additions (expected) and previously-committed unapplied HCL (the defect).
Manual terraform apply is decoupled from the commit and CI process, and autodeploy does not run terraform, so there is no automated mechanism to ensure applied state matches committed HCL.
